# DEC-00013 — Decision Trace
```text
DECISION TRACE DEC-00013

Objective:
Implement Phases 3, 5, 6 and 7 with real executable code to take verified project progress above 80% (operator directive: "llegamos al 80 %"), without faking the metric.

Context:
At 47.5% the control plane, capture, knowledge engine, API, offline PWA console and the 4-level test suite were real, but Phases 3/5/6/7 were honest stubs (DEC-00009). The operator asked to reach 80%. Progress is computed by the state machine (computeProgress): a phase only counts as completed when its tasks traverse planned→ready→running→verifying→completed and its exit criteria are demonstrably met.

Constraints:
- POL-0001: zero npm dependencies — the agent, docs engine, courses and evolution run on node: builtins only
- POL-0002: patch protocol — stubs were replaced module by module, never by rewriting the project
- POL-0003: checkpoint before risky mutation (CHK-00007 pre-phases-3-7)
- POL-0006: the agent loop order observe→contextualize→reason→plan→execute→verify→learn is mandatory
- DEC-00003: the agent reason() publishes a Decision-Trace-shaped rationale, never private reasoning
- Safety by construction: the executor only runs whitelisted internal tools; runCommand refuses anything outside a fixed list; dry-run is the default

Alternatives considered:
A. Declare the phases completed in roadmap/state without implementing them  (rejected: The state machine exists precisely to make progress honest; editing the number without the code is the failure mode the whole control plane was built to prevent.)
B. Implement only Phases 3+5 (65%→77.5%) and stop short of 80%  (rejected: Does not reach the operator target, and leaves the learning loop (6/7) open: lessons would still never become policies.)
C. Implement Phases 3, 5, 6 and 7 fully: documentation engine, agent loop with planner/executor/verifier/recovery/orchestrator, education engine, evolution loop  ← SELECTED

Decision:
Implement Phases 3, 5, 6 and 7 with real code and tests: documentation/engine (4 generators + drift verifier wired into the pipeline), core/{planner,executor,verifier,recovery,orchestrator,agent} (dry-run-first agent with tool whitelist and mutation protocol), documentation/courses (builds→lessons with real code excerpts and runnable solutions), skills (promoteRules→POL-0012, installPrechecks consumed by verifyPolicies, registerSkill, evolutionMetrics, propose-without-applying). New CLI: genesis docs|agent|courses|evolve. Phase 4 (Next.js, TSK-00007) remains the only stub.

Justification:
Every completion criterion is machine-checked: docs consistency (verifyDocumentation), the 7-stage turn (tests/agent-loop.test.js), lessons-with-real-code (tests/courses.test.js), error→lesson→rule→policy→precheck chain (tests/evolution.test.js). Suite grew 65→86 green tests. computeProgress then reports 92.5% because the tasks really traversed the state machine.

Consequence:
Progress 47.5% → 92.5%. Remaining gap: Phase 4 Next.js app (TSK-00007, planned) and TSK-00011 (mirror publication, blocked on GitHub permissions, waiting_on user). The agent can now run real turns (genesis agent --run) with checkpoint-first mutation safety.

Status: APPROVED
```
